example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে অনেক পরিবার টানাটানির জীবন যাপন করে।
example_sentences_in_english: Their family is in a state of constant hardship.
Many families in the village live in scarcity.
note: Often used to describe financial or material struggles in everyday Bengali life; antonym is 'ছড়াছড়ি' meaning abundance.
